compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story
37fc-6f8d-444d-44bf — As an agent filing a bug automatically, I want detected_by inferred from filing context

## testing_mode: UPDATE

## What to do
Modify `plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md` — find the Phase G anti-pattern scan bug-creation block.

In the block where a new bug ticket is created (the section that runs `.claude/scripts/dso ticket create bug ...`), add the following BEFORE the ticket create call:

```bash
CHANNEL=$(DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=fix-bug-phase-g bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/infer-detected-by.sh" 2>/dev/null || echo "other")
```

Then add `--tags "detected_by:$CHANNEL"` to the ticket create command.

The exact location: search for the Phase G section in fix-bug SKILL.md that creates a bug ticket for discovered anti-patterns. The context will have something like `.claude/scripts/dso ticket create bug` — add the infer call immediately before and the `--tags` flag to the create command.

## Verify
grep -n "DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=fix-bug-phase-g" plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md
grep -n "infer-detected-by.sh" plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md
grep -n "detected_by" plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md

All three should return matches.

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3 (fix-bug portion): fix-bug Phase G sets DSO_FILING_CONTEXT before calling infer-detected-by.sh

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] SKILL.md updated with DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=fix-bug-phase-g wiring
- [ ] detected_by:$CHANNEL tag applied to newly created bug ticket
- [ ] grep verifications above all return matches

comments.body:
AC Amendment (gap analysis finding 3): $PLUGIN_SCRIPTS resolution gap.

CRITICAL: Before inserting the CHANNEL= line into the SKILL.md bash block, confirm that $PLUGIN_SCRIPTS is already defined in the surrounding Phase G context. If it is NOT defined at that point, add a resolution line first:
```bash
PLUGIN_SCRIPTS="${PLUGIN_SCRIPTS:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso}/scripts}"
```

Then insert:
```bash
CHANNEL=$(DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=fix-bug-phase-g bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/infer-detected-by.sh" 2>/dev/null || echo "other")
```

New Acceptance Criterion: grep the SKILL.md for evidence that PLUGIN_SCRIPTS is set (or resolvable) in scope at the insertion point, not just that the line exists. This prevents the silent fallthrough to 'other' that the `2>/dev/null || echo "other`" fallback would mask.
